description: Vercel is a deployment and hosting platform with a REST API for managing projects, deployments and domains.
auth_notes: Vercel Access Tokens are sent in the Authorization header. OAuth2 (Sign in with Vercel) is available for apps, including JWT client assertions.
gate_detail: Access Tokens are created in account settings. Sources do not state plan requirements. Sign in with Vercel API Permissions appears to be a private beta needing access request.
api_scope: Programmatic control of deployments, domains, projects, environment variables, teams, webhooks, storage and more via HTTPS endpoints under api.vercel.com.
mcp_notes: Vercel docs list a Vercel MCP page under agent resources; the URL is not stated in the sources.
blocker_detail: No payment or approval gate stated for Access Tokens; only the Sign in with Vercel API Permissions private beta requires access.

evidence.quote: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API. Include the token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
Create and manage Access Tokens in your account settings .
All endpoints live under the URL https://api.vercel.com and follow the REST architecture.
A JWT that proves the client's identity, either a JWT assertion you sign or an OIDC token from a trusted issuer.
How can we get access to the private beta?

uncertainties: Sources do not state whether a free plan suffices for tokens.
No sandbox environment is described; Sandbox is a separate compute product.
The MCP URL and official status rest on a navigation listing.
